name: Polar Filament (Douglas Innovation)
summary: Troy, Michigan filament manufacturer founded in 2017 and selling publicly since 2021, trading as Douglas Innovation. Markets an all-domestic supply chain - US resin (NatureWorks 4043D for PLA), US spools and US colorants - and also acts as a white-label extruder for roughly nine other US brands.

oem_relationships.notes: Polar states it white-labels filament for approximately nine other US brands. None is named publicly, so this edge records the arrangement without a counterparty; if any of those brands is later identified, split this into a named edge.

product_lines.name: Polar PLA
product_lines.notes: Built on NatureWorks Ingeo 4043D, a named US resin - unusually specific disclosure for a retail brand.

product_lines.name: TPU 72D / 60D / 95A
product_lines.notes: Three shore grades spanning rigid-flexible to mainstream flexible.

product_lines.name: Anti-Static
product_lines.notes: ESD/anti-static grade whose base polymer is not stated; abs-esd and petg-esd both presuppose a base that is not confirmed here, so no id is mapped.

product_lines.name: Polar PHA
product_lines.notes: Polyhydroxyalkanoate or PLA/PHA blend; blend ratio not published.

additional_notes: Pricing about USD 25/kg. The 100%-USA claim covers resin, spool and colorant sourcing, not just extrusion, which is stronger than the usual 'made in USA' assembly claim. The white-label business means some other US-branded filament on the market is physically Polar product.

provenance.conflicts: The count of white-label clients (~9) and their identities come from the company's own statements and are not independently verifiable.
